hook.name: TrinityHookV10Collect
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages a single owner-controlled liquidity position with an allowlisted LP set and a dynamic fee configured at pool initialization. Accrued LP fees are harvested off the swap path via permissionless collectFees(), forwarding both the token-side and quote-side fees to a treasury feeRecipient multisig Safe.
